title: COL17: task-specific bit control with exact two-root-n work

claims.statement: For COL17 in proof.md, label-tools.md and gradient-tools.md, for every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ let n=ceil(log2 N). Use its exact finite branch for n<262144 and its fully specified large-branch parameters, depth-first collimation, known-frequency root output and fully counted classical grid estimation, all-moduli recovery and global source/work caps for n>=262144. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3. On every execution branch the SAME configuration has total charged sequential work T=O(n^(13/2) 2^((2) sqrt n)), jointly with all other resource bounds and clean-input tolerance below. All outside constants are absolute. The supported envelope has exact growth index 1/2. Complete charged classical/circuit generation, addressing, initialization, quantum scratch, preparation, precision and all unsuccessful attempts are proved in the evidence. The displayed time/sample representative is for n>=2; n=1 has the specified fixed absolute cost and sample bound.

On every execution branch the SAME configuration has total acquired source copies Q=O(n^2 2^((1) sqrt n)), including every filter, failed tree and restart; for n>=262144 its literal cap is Qcap from proof.md, and for n<262144 it is at most N(n+2), jointly with all other resource bounds and clean-input tolerance below. All outside constants are absolute. The supported envelope has exact growth index 1/2. Complete charged classical/circuit generation, addressing, initialization, quantum scratch, preparation, precision and all unsuccessful attempts are proved in the evidence. For the same COL17 configuration in proof.md, label-tools.md and gradient-tools.md, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and Q the ACTUAL number of source copies acquired (including filters and discarded trees), the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every acquired copy is an independent ideal coset state. Under this promise unconditional full-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch, including source/work-clock aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
